aluminum_melting_1.name: Melting of Aluminum - Level 1
aluminum_melting_1.description: Simulate the melting of Aluminum by heating under NPT conditions using the Embedded Atom Method potential and the given simulation parameters. The simulation should replicate the system by 3 times in each direction. Use the partial radial distribution function (RDF) to determine the Al-Al bond length after melting. Report the bond length corresponding to the first RDF peak in Å.
